title: Apple TV’s Cape Fear remake turns it into a paranoid tech thriller
summary: Cape Fear isn’t simply adding modern references to make its story feel more timely. The inclusion of so much technology makes Cape Fear feel like a modern story — but it’s also what gives this version its terrifying new edge.
